lines: Mallika R Iyer, Promoter Group, holds 1,234,500 shares, worth ₹166.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the trigger is recent.
They are not selling in the offer, so no proceeds are shown; the timing is pre-Offer capital, unlocked since 9 Sep 2026.
Confidence is medium: not in the seller table, though holdings agree across promoter_holding and shareholding_pattern.
